name: Intersection
description: Overlapping geometry shared by both layers.

name: Union
description: Combine features of A and B, splitting on overlaps.

name: Difference
description: Features of layer A that do not overlap layer B.

name: Symmetrical difference
description: Portions of A and B that do not overlap each other.

name: Clip
description: Cut layer A to the boundary of layer B.

name: Split with lines
description: Split polygons or lines of A using lines of B.

name: Update
description: Overwrite A geometry where it overlaps B.

name: Line intersections
description: Find the points where two line layers cross.

name: Buffer
description: Zone of a fixed distance around each feature.

name: Variable distance buffer
description: Buffer sized from an attribute field.

name: Convex hull
description: Smallest convex polygon enclosing features.

name: Concave hull
description: Tight-fitting boundary around a point cloud.

name: Dissolve
description: Merge adjacent features sharing an attribute.

name: Eliminate sliver polygons
description: Absorb tiny slivers into their largest neighbour.

name: Multipart to singleparts
description: Explode multipart features into single parts.

name: Promote to multipart
description: Group single features into multipart records.

name: Merge lines
description: Join connected line segments into single lines.

name: Subdivide
description: Break large features into smaller parts.

name: Centroids
description: Mass centre point of each feature.

name: Point on surface
description: A point guaranteed to lie inside each feature.

name: Extract vertices
description: Output every vertex as a point layer.

name: Densify by count
description: Insert N extra vertices between existing ones.

name: Densify by interval
description: Add vertices at a fixed spacing.

name: Simplify
description: Reduce vertex count while keeping shape.

name: Smooth
description: Round sharp corners of lines and polygons.

name: Add geometry attributes
description: Append area, length and perimeter fields.

name: Polygons to lines
description: Convert polygon boundaries into lines.

name: Lines to polygons
description: Close lines into polygon features.

name: Points to path
description: Connect ordered points into a line.

name: Fix geometries
description: Repair invalid or self-intersecting geometry.

name: Delete holes
description: Remove interior rings from polygons.

name: Force right-hand rule
description: Normalise ring winding order.

name: Collect geometries
description: Aggregate features into a single record.

name: Extend lines
description: Lengthen line ends by a set distance.

name: Explode lines
description: Split lines into individual segments.

name: Swap X and Y
description: Flip coordinate ordering.

name: Rotate
description: Rotate features around an anchor.

name: Translate
description: Shift features by an X/Y offset.

name: Affine transform
description: Scale, rotate and shear in one pass.

name: Select by location
description: Select A features by spatial relation to B.

name: Select by attribute
description: Select features matching a field value.

name: Select by expression
description: Select using an expression rule.

name: Random selection
description: Select a random subset of features.

name: Random selection within subsets
description: Random pick per attribute group.

name: Select within distance
description: Select A within a distance of B.

name: Extract by location
description: Copy located features to a new layer.

name: Extract by attribute
description: Copy attribute-matched features out.

name: Extract by expression
description: Copy expression-matched features out.

name: Outlier geometries
description: Flag isolated, oversized or undersized geometry and export a derived subset layer.

name: Distance matrix
description: All pairwise distances between two layers.

name: Mean coordinates
description: Average centre point of a layer.

name: Nearest neighbour analysis
description: Clustering statistics for a point layer.

name: Basic statistics for fields
description: Min, max, mean and more per field.

name: Sum line lengths
description: Total line length falling in each polygon.

name: Count points in polygon
description: Tally A points inside each B polygon.

name: List unique values
description: Distinct values found in a field.

name: Overlap analysis
description: Area and percent overlap between layers.

name: Nearest hub
description: Assign each feature to its closest hub.

name: Join by nearest
description: Attach attributes from the closest feature.

name: Merge vector layers
description: Combine several layers into one.

name: Split vector layer
description: Split into layers by a field value.

name: Reproject layer
description: Transform to a new coordinate system.

name: Join attributes by value
description: Table join on a matching field.

name: Join attributes by location
description: Join attributes by spatial relation.

name: Create spatial index
description: Build an index to speed up queries.

name: Add autoincremental field
description: Append a sequential ID field.

name: Add field
description: Create a new empty attribute field.

name: Refactor fields
description: Rename, retype and reorder fields.

name: Rename field
description: Change a single field's name.

name: Drop field
description: Remove one or more fields.

name: Field calculator
description: Compute a field from an expression.

name: Assign projection
description: Set the CRS without transforming.

name: Random points in area
description: Scatter randomly-spaced points inside polygons — or a buffered corridor around lines/points — with optional AWS terrain elevation.

name: Regular points
description: Generate a uniform point grid.

name: Points along geometry
description: Place points at intervals along lines.

name: Random points on lines
description: Scatter random points along lines.

name: Create grid
description: Build a rectangular or hex grid.

name: Points from table
description: Build a point layer from X/Y columns.

name: Voronoi polygons
description: Thiessen polygons around input points.

name: Delaunay triangulation
description: Triangular mesh over a point set.

name: Hub distance to points
description: Distance from each feature to nearest hub.

name: Hub lines
description: Draw lines from features to their hub.

name: Snap geometries to layer
description: Snap A vertices onto B within tolerance.

name: Shortest path (point to point)
description: Least-cost route between two points.

name: Shortest path (layer to point)
description: Routes from many origins to one point.

name: Service area (from point)
description: Reachable area within a cost budget.

name: Service area (from layer)
description: Service areas for many origins.

name: Split lines by maximum length
description: Cut lines to a maximum segment length.

name: Delete duplicate geometries
description: Remove features with identical geometry.

name: Remove null geometries
description: Drop features with empty geometry.

name: Check validity
description: Report invalid geometry with reasons.

name: Snap points to grid
description: Round coordinates to a grid resolution.

name: Drop M/Z values
description: Strip measure and elevation dimensions.

name: Set Z value
description: Assign a Z coordinate to all vertices.
